ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 8% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized in linear and cluster patterns against 92% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white linear filaments distributed diagonally across the right lobe (image plane); high-intensity circular cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe (image plane); remainder is solid low-intensity dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with low pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys; higher frequency of serration visible on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitting the trajectory of both trailing edges, tapering towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel blobs at the terminal tip of the left lobe (image plane).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) predominantly on the right lobe (image plane), with secondary parallel sets on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both visible lobes; localized white scarring/colonization marks on the left lobe tip.
